label: kizuna_health_b_01
text: Hey there! Come on in! Everyone’s welcome in\nthe nurse’s office![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_03a
text: Oh, so you know you’re tough stuff, huh?\nHahaha. But seriously—you look a bit different![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_03b
text: What? No, you definitely have...more confidence\nor something![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_04
text: I bet it’s because of all the crazy experiences\nyou’re having on your Treasure Hunt.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_05
text: You need to tell me all about what you’ve been\nup to![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_07
text: I sure am jealous of you kids. You get to try out\nnew things every single day.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_09
text: I actually wanted to become a teacher.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_10
text: I’m just the school nurse, y’know? I can’t teach\nclasses or anything like that.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_11
text: I couldn’t pass the certification exam to become\nan actual health teacher.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_12
text: I took it so many times, but no luck. So here I\nam...stuck forever in the nurse’s office.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_13
text: Oh, uh...sorry. I guess this isn’t a very fun thing to\ntalk about.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_14
text: But you’re just such a good listener! I find myself\ntelling you all kinds of stuff.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_15
text: I hope you’ll still come see me even if I talk your\near off like this.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_b_system_01
text: You became even closer with Nurse Miriam!
